q1_issues.issue: "a single lantern" states an exact count / exclusivity ("only one"), but the parse slots `single` as a descriptive property of the lantern, asserting the lantern is single rather than that the cove holds exactly one.

q2_gaps: quantity-emphasis "a single N" on a SINGULAR indefinite: `Cardinality` / `CardinalityAtLeast` are defined only over a plural group witness, and the closest analogue the instruction set names ("only one N") is itself a registered gap under Focus particles, so nothing licenses an exact-count-one carrier here
notes: Everything else is squarely licensed: "Sunken Cove" is a capitalized run exceeding the bare class word, so name + kind-word type atom is the Names-and-casing pattern, and `Agent` on stative-transitive "hold" matches the instruction set's own "the tank holds forty litres" example.
